name: @fireflies/look
description: The look the shown layout asks for, drawn: Nocturne's dithered chrome where the layout is dithered, herdr-app's plain one elsewhere (docs/plain-look.md). Served by the app as a built-in library; this file lets tsc, oxlint and bun find it (in this repo through the workspace, in a mod's own repository where `herdr-app types` writes it). Its peer is the Effect the app serves.
